grammarPoint.title: Plural nouns
grammarPoint.summary: Learn how to make nouns plural to talk about more than one thing, including regular -s/-es endings and common irregular forms.
grammarPoint.explanation:
Most nouns become plural by adding *-s* to the end. For example, one "cat" becomes two "cats." One "apple" becomes many "apples." This is the most common way to form plurals.

If a noun ends with *-s, -sh, -ch, -x,* or *-z*, we add *-es* to make it plural. For instance, one "bus" becomes two "buses." One "box" becomes many "boxes." This rule helps with pronunciation.

Some nouns have irregular plural forms. This means they do not follow the -s or -es rules. For example, one "man" becomes two "men," and one "child" becomes many "children." You need to learn these special words.
patterns: noun ending in s, sh, ch, x, z + es (e.g., bus -> buses)

examples.text: There are three buses at the station.
examples.note: Shows a plural with -es for a noun ending in -s.

examples.text: The children play in the park.
examples.note: Shows an irregular plural form of 'child'.

examples.text: My feet are tired after walking.
examples.note: Shows an irregular plural form of 'foot'.

commonErrors.note: Remember to add -s for most plural nouns.

commonErrors.wrong: There are many womans in the room.
commonErrors.right: There are many women in the room.
commonErrors.note: Some nouns have irregular plural forms.

exercises.question: How do you make "cat" plural?
exercises.explanation: Most nouns add -s to become plural.

exercises.question: Choose the correct plural form for "box."
exercises.explanation: Nouns ending in -x add -es to become plural.

exercises.question: I have two ___ in my bag.
exercises.explanation: "Pens" is the correct plural form for "pen."

exercises.text: I see many ___ in the garden.
exercises.explanation: "Flowers" is the regular plural form of "flower."

exercises.text: She has two ___ for her new dress.
exercises.explanation: Nouns ending in -ch add -es to form the plural.

exercises.text: There are five ___ in the car.
exercises.explanation: "People" is the irregular plural form of "person."
